lines.text: Write dog with a small d!
Many learners say: I have a Dog and a Cat.
Better: I have a dog and a cat.
Most words start with a small letter.
Dog with a small d! I have a dog.

data.wrong: I have a Dog and a Cat.
data.right: I have a dog and a cat.
data.why: Most words start with a small letter.

en.tip: German writes all nouns with a capital letter. English uses small letters, except for names, languages, days and months.
en.caption: English nouns use small letters! Wrong: “I have a Dog and a Cat.” Right: “I have a dog and a cat.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
